service-loader-concept.title: Discover service providers with ServiceLoader
service-loader-concept.short: Load implementations through a standard service contract
service-loader-concept.summary: ServiceLoader discovers implementations of a service interface without hard-coding provider classes.
service-loader-concept.why: Providers can be added through module declarations or service configuration while consumers depend on the service abstraction.
service-loader-concept.tips: In named modules, declare uses on the consumer and provides ... with on the provider.

varhandle-concept.title: Access variables through VarHandle
varhandle-concept.short: Use typed variable handles with defined memory semantics
varhandle-concept.summary: VarHandle provides strongly typed access to fields and array elements, including atomic and ordered operations.
varhandle-concept.why: It exposes low-level concurrency operations through a standard API without relying on internal unsafe APIs.
varhandle-concept.tips: Choose the weakest access mode whose ordering guarantees satisfy the algorithm.

path-resolve-sibling.title: Build a sibling path
path-resolve-sibling.short: Use Path.resolveSibling for a file beside another file
path-resolve-sibling.summary: resolveSibling replaces the final path component relative to the same parent.
path-resolve-sibling.why: It avoids manually converting paths to strings and rebuilding parent directories.
path-resolve-sibling.tips: Remember that a path with no parent resolves the supplied sibling directly.

objects-check-index.title: Validate an index with Objects.checkIndex
objects-check-index.short: Check 0 <= index < length in one call
objects-check-index.summary: Objects.checkIndex validates an index and returns it when valid.
objects-check-index.why: It centralizes the usual bounds rule and throws IndexOutOfBoundsException consistently.
objects-check-index.tips: Use checkFromToIndex or checkFromIndexSize for ranges rather than checking endpoints manually.

unresolved-address-exception.title: UnresolvedAddressException
unresolved-address-exception.short: A channel cannot use an unresolved socket address
unresolved-address-exception.summary: NIO channels can reject an InetSocketAddress whose host name has not been resolved.
unresolved-address-exception.why: The channel operation needs a concrete network address before it can connect or bind.
unresolved-address-exception.tips: Resolve host names before passing addresses to channel operations and handle name-resolution failures separately.

non-readable-channel-exception.title: NonReadableChannelException
non-readable-channel-exception.short: Read only from a channel opened for reading
non-readable-channel-exception.summary: A channel operation throws NonReadableChannelException when reading is attempted on a channel without read capability.
non-readable-channel-exception.why: FileChannel open options determine which operations the resulting channel permits.
non-readable-channel-exception.tips: Include StandardOpenOption.READ when the channel must read data.

yield-outside-switch-expression-error.title: yield outside a switch expression
yield-outside-switch-expression-error.short: Use yield only to produce a switch-expression value
yield-outside-switch-expression-error.summary: A yield statement is valid only within a switch expression that needs a result value.
yield-outside-switch-expression-error.why: yield transfers a value to the enclosing switch expression, so there is no target outside one.
yield-outside-switch-expression-error.tips: Use return for a method result and reserve yield for block-form switch-expression arms.

record-accessor-return-type-error.title: Record accessor has the wrong return type
record-accessor-return-type-error.short: A record accessor must match its component type
record-accessor-return-type-error.summary: An explicitly declared record accessor must return exactly the type of its record component.
record-accessor-return-type-error.why: Record components define the accessor signatures that form part of the record contract.
record-accessor-return-type-error.tips: Keep the generated accessor unless custom behavior is needed; if declared, match its name and return type.

divzero-lint-warning.title: Division by zero lint warning
divzero-lint-warning.short: Do not use a constant zero integer divisor
divzero-lint-warning.summary: With divzero lint enabled, javac warns when an integer division or remainder uses the constant zero as divisor.
divzero-lint-warning.why: The expression will fail with ArithmeticException if executed, so the constant divisor is almost always a defect.
divzero-lint-warning.tips: Validate a variable divisor before division instead of suppressing the warning.

string-split-trailing-empty-trap.title: String.split drops trailing empty fields
string-split-trailing-empty-trap.short: Use a negative limit when trailing empty fields matter
string-split-trailing-empty-trap.summary: The one-argument String.split removes trailing empty strings from its result.
string-split-trailing-empty-trap.why: It behaves like split(regex, 0), whose zero limit discards trailing empty substrings.
string-split-trailing-empty-trap.tips: Pass -1 as the limit when parsing records where a final empty column is significant.
